extension.description: Vivado project hierarchy, Block Design wiring views, and AI-assisted workflows. RTL analysis is provided by the Airtl native library.
command.explainModule: Explain Module with AI (Source and Project Context)
command.openDefinition: Go to Module Definition (double click / right-click)
config.title: Vivado Project Explorer
config.ai.enabled: Automatically initialize AI integration when VS Code opens (start the tool and restore the project session). When disabled, AI starts only when you trigger it manually.
config.ai.tool: AI tool used by the extension. OpenCode is the default.
config.ai.tool.claude: Claude Code: headless claude -p mode with session resume support.
config.ai.tool.opencode: OpenCode (default): sends messages through its HTTP API and restores the project's TUI session on activation.
config.ai.tool.dsh: DeepSeek Harness. Configure vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.dsh.command to use it.
config.ai.tool.zcode: ZCode. Configure vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.zcode.command to use it.
config.ai.tool.generic: Custom command adapter configured with vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.generic.command.
config.ai.autoFallback: Try another available AI tool when the configured tool cannot start.
config.ai.dsh.command: Command template for DeepSeek Harness. Leave empty to disable this adapter.
config.ai.zcode.command: Command template for ZCode. Leave empty to disable this adapter.
config.exportMode: Where selected Block Design files are exported.
config.exportCommand: VS Code command to invoke when exportMode is command. The file list is passed as an argument.
